analysis.title: GS Coppersmith - US Equities: heightened demand for protection
key_insights: Friday 10/16 was the first real sign of panic in index protection after weeks of damage in individual stocks and client portfolios. VIX futures traded 3.6x the 20-day average, Cboe index put volume was the highest daily volume on record, and total put volume was the fourth-highest back to 2015.
VIX call option volume was the second-highest in five years, behind only August 2, 2024, which preceded the VIX spike above 60 the following Monday.

One estimate shows dealer gamma fell by $5.9bn on Friday alone, leaving aggregate positioning close to neutral. Monthly expiration likely contributed, but the desk says the loss of positive dealer gamma matters because the index has been insulated from large single-stock and sector moves this year and that insulation now looks more vulnerable.

GS PB data: US L/S net leverage fell 3.2pts last week, the largest weekly decline since Liberation Day and fourth-largest in five years. Net leverage is 43.7%, a five-year low. Fundamental L/S managers lost 1.68% and systematic managers 1.20% between October 9-15 while global equities were broadly flat.
Global Tech saw its largest percentage net selling on record since 2016, with semis accounting for 57% of US technology net selling.

Essentially all of the hedge fund net exposure reduction since end of July came from added shorts, not long reductions. Short exposure is near five-year highs and long exposure is in the 53rd percentile over three years and 72nd over five years. Further de-grossing through long sales and short covering is possible if performance pressure continues.

The AI correction has become a debate about financing the buildout. AI-related HY spreads widened 25bp by midweek versus 2bp for non-AI issuers. GS Research forecasts $720bn of combined project finance and direct hyperscaler issuance in 2027.

GIR still expects S&P 500 earnings to grow 11% in 2027, or 18% adjusting for distortions. Over the last two weeks 10yr yields fell more than 20bp while HY spreads widened. The desk separates a market pricing slower growth from one pricing outright earnings deterioration.

Desk takeaway: the market is moving into a different volatility environment but not necessarily a more bearish one. With net exposure at five-year lows, shorts near five-year highs and protection demand accelerating, a considerable amount of caution is already in positioning.

Growth and cost-of-capital concerns could shift from slower growth to earnings deterioration.

tension_points.bull_case: Net exposure at five-year lows, shorts near five-year highs and accelerating protection demand mean a considerable amount of caution is already in positioning. The market is moving into a different volatility environment, not necessarily a more bearish one, and GIR still sees 2027 S&P earnings growth of 11%.
tension_points.bear_case: Dealer gamma fell $5.9bn, so the index is more exposed to the volatility seen in single stocks. Long exposure is still elevated (53rd/72nd percentiles), leaving room for further de-grossing if performance pressure continues. AI financing costs are rising, with AI HY spreads +25bp.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Continued hedge fund performance pressure forcing further de-grossing through long sales and short covering.
